privacy-policy.html:
At The Burger Sleeves, accessible from https://theburgersleeves.com/, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting any personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit our website or contact us.

Information We Collect

When you use our website, we may collect the following information:

  • Name, email address, phone number, and company name (when you fill out a contact or quote form)

  • Order or inquiry details related to burger sleeves or packaging

  • IP address, browser type, device information, and pages visited

  • Cookies and usage data to improve website performance

We only collect information that is necessary to communicate with you and provide our services.

How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information for purposes such as:

  • Responding to inquiries and quote requests

  • Processing orders and providing customer support

  • Improving our website, products, and services

  • Sending updates related to your inquiry or order

  • Preventing fraud and ensuring website security

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.

Cookies and Tracking Technologies

The Burger Sleeves uses cookies to enhance user experience and analyze website traffic. Cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website.

You can disable cookies through your browser settings, but some features of the website may not function properly.

Third-Party Services

We may use trusted third-party tools such as analytics, hosting providers, and email services to operate our website efficiently. These third parties have access to limited information only to perform specific tasks and are obligated to protect your data.

Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

Your Data Protection Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  • Request access to your personal data

  • Request correction or deletion of your data

  • Object to or restrict processing of your data

To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details below.

Children’s Information

The Burger Sleeves does not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If you believe your child has provided personal data on our website, please contact us immediately, and we will remove it.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:

Website:https://theburgersleeves.com/
Email:info@theburgersleeves.com

shipping-policy.html:
At The Burger Sleeves, we aim to deliver your packaging orders efficiently and securely. This Shipping Policy outlines how orders are processed, shipped, and delivered.

Order Processing Time

  • Custom orders (printed, branded, or personalized burger sleeves) typically require 7–14 business days for production after final artwork approval.

  • Stock orders are usually processed within 2–5 business days.

  • Processing times may vary depending on order quantity, design complexity, and material availability.

Orders are processed on business days only (excluding weekends and holidays).

Shipping Methods

We work with reliable courier and freight partners to ship orders safely. Shipping methods and carriers may vary based on destination, order size, and shipping option selected at checkout.

Shipping costs are calculated based on:

  • Order size and weight

  • Delivery destination

  • Selected shipping method

Estimated Delivery Time

Delivery time begins after the order has been processed and shipped.

Estimated delivery times may vary depending on:

  • Shipping carrier

  • Destination country or region

  • Customs clearance (for international shipments)

Delivery times are estimates and are not guaranteed.

International Shipping

We offer international shipping to selected countries.

  • Customers are responsible for any customs duties, taxes, or import fees

  • Delays caused by customs authorities are outside our control

Please ensure your shipping details are accurate to avoid delivery issues.

Shipping Confirmation & Tracking

Once your order is shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking details (when available). Tracking information may take up to 24 hours to become active.

Incorrect or Incomplete Address

The Burger Sleeves is not responsible for delays or non-delivery due to incorrect or incomplete shipping addresses provided by the customer. Additional shipping charges may apply for re-shipment.

Damaged Shipments

If your order arrives damaged, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery and provide clear photographs of:

  • The damaged product

  • The outer shipping box

  • The shipping label

We will review the issue and assist with a replacement or solution where applicable.

Lost or Delayed Shipments

While we work closely with our shipping partners, we are not responsible for delays caused by carriers, weather conditions, customs, or other factors beyond our control.

Shipping Costs

  • Shipping fees are non-refundable

  • Any additional charges incurred due to re-delivery or address corrections are the responsibility of the customer

Contact Us

If you have questions about our Shipping Policy or need assistance with your order, please contact us:

Website:https://theburgersleeves.com/
Email:info@theburgersleeves.com

refund_returns.html:
Thank you for choosing The Burger Sleeves. We take pride in delivering quality custom and stock burger sleeve packaging. This Refund and Returns Policy explains the conditions under which refunds or replacements may be issued.

Custom Products

All custom burger sleeves, including products with printing, branding, logos, custom sizes, or special finishes, are non-refundable and non-returnable once production has started.

Because custom packaging is made according to your specifications, we cannot accept returns or issue refunds for custom orders unless there is a manufacturing defect or an error on our part.

Stock Products

For non-custom (stock) burger sleeves, returns may be accepted under the following conditions:

  • The item must be unused and in original packaging

  • The return request must be submitted within 7 days of delivery

  • The product must be in resalable condition

Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer unless the return is due to our error.

Damaged or Defective Items

If your order arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with clear photographs of:

  • The damaged product

  • The outer packaging

  • The shipping label

After review, we may offer a replacement or refund, depending on the situation.

Order Cancellations

  • Orders can be canceled before production begins.

  • Once production has started, cancellations are not possible for custom orders.

Any cancellation requests must be submitted as soon as possible.

Refund Processing

Approved refunds will be processed to the original payment method. Please allow 7–10 business days for the refund to reflect, depending on your payment provider or bank.

Shipping Costs

Shipping charges are non-refundable, except in cases where the refund is due to an error made by The Burger Sleeves.

Non-Returnable Items

The following items are not eligible for return or refund:

  • Custom printed burger sleeves

  • Personalized or branded packaging

  • Clearance or discounted items

  • Orders damaged due to improper storage or handling after delivery

Contact Us

If you have any questions about our Refund and Returns Policy, please contact us:

Website:https://theburgersleeves.com/
Email:info@theburgersleeves.com
